summary_1line: Rama hears the monkeys’ doubts about Vibhishana but declares that anyone seeking refuge—even an enemy—must be granted protection.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands calmly among the gathered monkey chiefs as they argue, while the distant figure of Vibhishana waits in the sky seeking refuge.
Rama raises his hand in assurance, declaring protection for anyone who comes saying 'I am yours.'
A lone pigeon offers its own flesh to a hawk that had taken refuge with it, illustrating Rama’s story of ultimate hospitality.
